## Magic move example

::: {.magic-move-container data-lang="r"}

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(table(Year.Release))
```

[]{.fragment .magic-move-step}

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(
  table(Year.Release)
)
p <- game %>%
  select(Year.Release, Global.Sales)
```

[]{.fragment .magic-move-step}

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(
  table(Year.Release)
)
p <- game %>%
  select(Year.Release, Global.Sales) %>%
  group_by(Year.Release) %>%
  summarise(Total.Sales = sum(Global.Sales))
```

:::
